description: Policy for scripts/hooks/ledger-presence-guard.js. Ships in warn mode; set enforcement.mode to block after smoke validation. An optional enforcement.soft_rollout_until keeps a declared block at warn until that date.
notes: lookback_window_ms = how far back to scan recent events.jsonl rows when correlating a watched-command invocation to a ledger.write. 60s covers typical sprint command durations. anchor_missing_severity=loud_warn — if the target file lacks the section anchor entirely, the guard emits a stronger warn than the standard 'missing row' warn.
